I'll help you center the image in your MDX file. In Markdown/MDX, you can center images using HTML with a div and CSS styling, or using specific Markdown syntax if your setup supports it.

Here's how to modify the image in your file:

```mdx:blog/src/content/docs/blog/something-about-phosphenes.mdx

</div>

// Rest of the content...
```

Replace the current image line:
```

```

with the HTML version I provided above. This will center the image on the page.

Alternatively, if you prefer to keep using Markdown syntax and your setup supports custom classes, you could add a CSS class to your image like this:

```mdx:blog/src/content/docs/blog/something-about-phosphenes.mdx

```

But the HTML/div approach is more universally supported and should work in your current setup.
